prompts:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: right-facing complete-character animation sprite sheet for an existing office game. Input image is the EXACT character identity and clothing reference. Preserve this character's face, head and hair silhouette, outfit and body proportions, including distinguishing accessories. Clean fine dark outlines, soft anime chibi shading matching the reference. Full body RIGHT-facing in every frame, fixed orthographic side camera.

Deliver exactly EIGHT full-body frames in a 1536x1024 sheet, FOUR equal columns and TWO equal rows, 384x512 cells, reading left to right. Genuinely transparent alpha background, no cast shadow, no floor, no text, no borders or gridlines. One character per cell. Fixed head position/size and feet baseline in every cell. Entire figure about 450px high, hair top at cell y=40 and shoes at cell y=490, generously inside each cell. Same head, hair, torso, legs and shoes in all cells: do not animate the body standing position.

The character takes one sip from ONE SMALL WHITE CERAMIC MUG, using the NEAR arm visible on this side. Redraw that arm entirely for each pose: a naturally short upper arm attached at shoulder, elbow close to ribs, bent forearm, articulated wrist, visible hand/fingers wrapping mug handle. Remove the original dangling near arm when that same arm is raised. Exactly two connected arms total; far arm mostly hidden. No third arm, duplicate hand, elongated sleeve, straight pole from waist to mouth, telescoping limb or vertical sliding prop. Cup stays in front of body. Rim touches LIPS, never nose, when drinking.

Eight ordered poses:
1. Relaxed HOLD: elbow bent, hand holds upright mug at lower chest in front of body.
2. LIFT: elbow flexes, hand and mug arc upward; sleeve shows elbow bend.
3. APPROACH: mug near mouth, shoulder-elbow-wrist remain anatomically connected.
4. CONTACT: mug rim actually contacts lips, wrist neutral, visible bent arm and gripping hand.
5. SIP: keep rim at lips, visibly tilt mug toward mouth 25 degrees with wrist, eye gently closes; no head growth, no exaggerated neck tilt.
6. WITHDRAW: reopen eye, untilt mug, move it just away from lips.
7. LOWER: lower mug in a natural elbow arc toward chest.
8. HOLD: exactly return to pose 1 for seamless loop.

Consistent character scale, head placement, head contours, face, hair, outfit and shoe/leg positions across frames and rows. Only near arm/sleeve, hand, cup and eyelid move. All limbs within cells. High priority: natural elbow anatomy, cup-lip contact, identity and animation consistency.

Character-specific invariants: Light warm-brown short tousled hair with a small upward cowlick, cream hoodie with hood and drawstrings, dark navy trousers, white sneakers; preserve the exact cute reference face.
